detail.longDescription: I don't often listen to corporate broadcast radio, but today one of the stations in my market were using the phrase "guaranteed human" on most of their bumpers. Maybe 2 out of 3 yards in my neighborhood have anti AI/data center signs in their yards. Very few things unify people to this extent. Free software "leaders" are on the wrong side of history on this issue and need to get out of the house more to understand why. https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=JvTJTTUK8cg # ArtificialIntelligence # AI # noAI # OpenSource
